parent_contract.parent_fault: The stable P1 observer produced 3,088 resolved rows with zero observer fault, but its native HTML displayed 99% rather than the required 100% real-tick label. P1 outcomes were declared semantically unread and P2/P3 never opened.
parent_contract.correction_method: Acquire one family-owned US500 M15 bar-open/spread surface, prove exact P1 non-economic structural parity, and apply the unchanged sequential P1 discovery, P2 confirmation and P3 latest gates. No P2 or P3 economic value may be opened unless the prior fixed stage passes.

parent_files.role: ignored online-only parent P1 file; acquisition selects only 15 named non-economic structural columns

fixed_signal.evaluation: At each family-owned US500 M15 bar open, inspect only the immediately completed bar after proving current/completed and completed/predecessor deltas are each exactly 900 seconds.
fixed_signal.range: completed high minus low, finite and strictly positive
fixed_signal.trigger: absolute close_location at least 0.75, absolute body_fraction at least 0.50, and both nonzero signs equal
fixed_signal.native_direction: the shared sign of close_location and body_fraction
fixed_signal.rearm: No parameterized rearm; only one unresolved observation at a time.
fixed_signal.horizon: Resolve on the fourth subsequent physical US500 M15 market-bar open.
fixed_signal.pricing_proxy: Treat each acquired bar open as bid and ask as bid plus that bar's recorded spread points times point. Observed uses entry ask/exit bid for BUY or entry bid/exit ask for SELL; doubled-spread applies one further full entry and exit spread against the direction.
fixed_signal.profit_formula: signed price distance divided by trade_tick_size times trade_tick_value times 0.01

fixed_periods.role: select at most one direction after integrity, frequency and P1 economic gates
open only if P1 passes; confirm only the frozen P1 direction
open only if P2 passes; latest evidence may veto but cannot select or switch direction

required: all completed/entry/exit M15 coordinates equal after flooring parent first-tick timestamps to their containing M15 bars
all OHLC, direction and four-bar horizons equal
maximum absolute close-location and body-fraction difference at most 5.1e-10

P1_DISCOVERY_2025: at least 3.0 resolved triggers per eligible day
P2_CONFIRM_2026_JAN_MAY: at least 3.0 resolved triggers per eligible day
P3_LATEST_2026_JUN_JUL: at least 3.0 resolved triggers per eligible day

path_metrics: doubled-spread net divided by maximum closed doubled-spread drawdown
P1_direction_selection: doubled-spread profit factor is at least 1.10
fixed_economic_gates.P1_tie_break: larger doubled-spread net, then profit factor, then net-to-drawdown, then CONTINUATION before REVERSION
P2_confirmation: only the P1-selected direction is authoritative
P3_latest_check: only the already selected and confirmed direction is authoritative
pooled_selected_direction: summed path net divided by summed path maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.50
no one positive path supplies more than 70% of total positive doubled-spread net

sequential_opening_rule: Run and structurally validate P1 before any P1 economic metric.
If P1 frequency or both direction-selection gates fail, close without structurally or economically opening P2/P3.
If P1 selects one direction, open P2 and semantically aggregate only that direction for confirmation.
If P2 frequency or confirmation fails, close without structurally or economically opening P3.
Only after P2 passes may P3 and the final pooled selected-direction gate open.

decision.complete_pass: Retain exactly one non-automatic additive US500 prototype clue for the selected direction. Unit 121 itself opens no MQL, Strategy Tester, Optimization candidate or Live authority.
decision.valid_nonconfirmation: Close the exact Unit 036 question with no direction and no seed; do not reinterpret environment failure as the economic verdict.
decision.invalid_or_engineering: Correct without retry cap and without an economic verdict until one complete valid fixed sequential aggregation exists.
decision.fixed_replacement_candidate: unchanged unless a later separately declared Optimization campaign produces complete valid evidence
